extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of ancient Near Eastern and biblical chronology
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical and chronological account of Assyrian, Babylonian, and Median kings, correlating regnal years with the Nabonassar era and connecting events to biblical narratives and classical sources. Discusses sources (Herodotus, Josephus, Berosus, biblical books) and attempts to synchronize different chronologies.
